purpose: Review evidence for SPEC.md rebuild of the Inclusão Digital UEMG portal. These assets prove the proposed visual world across every raster role; they are not yet wired into production pages.

generator.credentialsHandling: AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY read from environment by the tool; never printed or committed

infrastructureReceipt.observation: On this Azure gpt-image-2 deployment, image_generate with quality=low completed reliably, while quality=medium and quality=high failed every attempt with a network error (request timeout at the transport layer). The Azure Foundry root endpoint answered HTTP 200 during the same window, so the base connection was healthy.

measurements.high_1536x864_with_reference_image: failed x2 (network error); the tec-image Azure helper also documents that this deployment does not accept a reference image for image-to-image

infrastructureReceipt.decision: Selected assets were generated at quality=low, which for gpt-image-2 still yields clean, review-grade output. Production finals may be re-rendered at a higher quality once the deployment accepts larger renders, or via a queue/retry path. Recorded here as the receipt behind the quality choice.

world.name: Ateliê de Autonomia
world.oneLine: A calm hand-cut-paper craft world set between a Brazilian public-university lab and the learner's own home, where older adults are shown as capable protagonists, never as helpless.
world.replaces: Colcha de Retalhos (chita quilt) - see SPEC.md section 4 for why.

freezeList.camera: seated eye level, wide contextual scenes; no forced perspective, no top-down
freezeList.lighting: clear warm daylight (late morning to afternoon)
freezeList.people: Brazilian adults aged 60-75, varied skin tones and genders, dignified everyday clothing, attentive and capable expressions; monitors read as equals
freezeList.environment: Brazilian public-university computer laboratory in Frutal and the learner's home living room/kitchen
freezeList.deviceLanguage: recognizable hardware shells with blank pale geometric screens; all real UI stays HTML/CSS/SVG

assets.promptSummary: Airy Brazilian public-university computer lab; three dignified adults 60-75 learn with a young monitor as an equal; hand-cut paper style; copy-safe field left third; blank pale screens.
assets.derivation: text-to-image; composition first explored in the rejected draft below
assets.readback: PASS - 3 elders + 1 monitor, lab with window/noticeboard (blank shapes), plants, blank screens, clean left copy field, clean hands, no text/logos

modelMayNotGenerate: real identifiable people without authorized reference
boundaries.identity: No real learner, monitor, or coordinator is depicted. Subjects are invented composites; the program preserves collective PAEx authorship and never fabricates testimonials or impact numbers.
